verdict.rationale: Greptile supports custom rules and repo-level config (greptile.json, custom-standards, strictness settings) that let teams define team-specific review criteria in plain language, and reviews run automatically on every PR — but there's no evidence of a structured 'define a named agentic check that must pass/fail to gate merge' system akin to CI-style pre-merge checks; it's closer to configurable review nitpicks/rules than discrete pass/fail assertions like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths'. missing for 10: explicit pass/fail check definitions, evidence of merge-blocking behavior tied to specific custom checks, and examples of natural-language check authoring beyond generic 'custom rules'.
